rationale: The freeze report reveals a verification and wording gap in existing Wave 2 indexing requirements. The new requirement extends FR-DOC-019, DR-DOC-010, and FR-DOC-022 rather than replacing them.

affected_existing_reqs.diff_summary: Narrow non-blocking execution to require real isolation for heavy native/CPU work.
Add worker-owned write connection and committed generation protection.
Prevent request-path HNSW rebuild and isolate HNSW maintenance work.
